messages:
marie: Quick sync: need an ops+product playbook for retiring models that balances customer continuity with infra constraints. Looking for a minimal, negotiable template we can reuse.

elsa: I can start drafting. Ideas: tiered sunset windows (soft sunset = 60d, hard sunset = 180d) and emergency extension process. Also propose a paid-long-pin offering for >6mo.

omar: From infra: long pins multiply state (KV caches, embeddings index versions). We need global limits and a per-tenant cap. Suggested defaults:
- per_tenant_pin_limit: 2
- global_soft_limit: 150
- default_pin_ttl_days: 90
If we exceed soft_limit, autoscaling triggered and account billed for extra memory.

jin: For quality gates, ML recommends: embedding drift <= 0.03 (mean cosine delta), utility regression <= 2% on curated prompts, and p95 latency delta <= 15%. If any fail, block deprecation.

dez: We should formalize an approval board for exceptions: product + infra + ML + legal. Exception requests create an audit record and require 2/4 approvals. Also include a short-lived emergency pin (30d) path that bypasses the board with an incident tag.

elsa: UI: request flow should collect: reason (checkboxes: compliance, regression, contract), requested_ttl, business_impact_note, and attach benchmark artifacts. Add a "pause sunset" toggle in the model detail page for approved pins.

marie: Legal: we need a short client-facing clause. Draft suggestion: "Redwood may retire models with at least X days' notice. Customers may request time-limited pin extensions; extended support may incur additional fees and reduced roadmap priority." Jin/elsa please loop legal for wording.

jin: CI template idea: bench job runs on pull request to the catalog with steps:
1) unit synthetic load @ target qps for 10m to capture p95
2) run 100 curated prompts for semantic diff + crowdscore pass/fail
3) compute embedding drift on golden set (1000 vectors)
If any check fails, mark "fail-deprecation".

omar: Ops note: add automated expiry emails at 45d, 21d, 7d, 3d, 1d and a console banner for pinned models. Also add a final kill guard: human-confirm for hard sunset.

dez: Cost model: for any customer pin > default_pin_ttl_days we should assess a surcharge: incremental infra + ops time. For enterprise SLAs on pinned models, captain sign-off required.

elsa: Negotiation playbook bullets for CS: offer migration voucher (3 months of discounted tokens), one migration runbook session, and option to buy extended pin. If they insist on >12mo, require contract amendment and pass-through cost.

marie: Two rollout gates before we start offering paid pins: 1) console flows implemented and audited; 2) approval board workflow + audit logs in place. Otherwise, we'll restrict to ad-hoc approvals.

ops-bot: INFO: current infra telemetry shows 42 pinned variants active; safe headroom to soft_limit=150.

jin: One more safety: build a live regression sampler (1% of traffic on new model) that evaluates output against baseline and produces daily report. If regressions > 2% for 24h, auto-flag and trigger rollback.

omar: Implementation tasks (rough ETA): infra limits + billing hooks (4d), expiry reminders + console banners (3d), audit log and approval UI (5d).

elsa: I'll produce the consumer-facing FAQ draft and the internal runbook by EOW.

marie: Action list
- Elsa: consumer FAQ + runbook (EOW)
- Omar: infra + billing spec (4d)
- Jin: CI template + regression sampler spec (3d)
- Dez: approval board flow + emergency pin path (3d)

marie: If no objections I'll convert this thread into RW-PL-7420 and assign tasks. Call out now.

jin: No objections from ML.

omar: OK from infra.

dez: OK.

elsa: OK.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-PL-7420 and assigned to @marie.
